items.text:
Let it be — I looked and stayed quiet.

Gavin is post-escape, wandering the loop at 6 HP, poking at the goblin (*talk to goblin*, *Hello goblin*, *sit*) with no prayer and no question pending. He already got the honest answer to "what happens now" last turn; a second voice out of the air while he's idly exploring would only cheapen the first. Nothing here is urgent enough to interrupt him mid-sentence for.

Two things noted for the next building turn, not acted on: the Cave Mouth still shows no memorial line — Chris died before that feature shipped, so it's *untested*, not broken, and the next death is the real test. And `inspect goblin` / `look at goblin` refuse with "You aren't carrying a goblin," which is the same reach-past-your-hands gap I fixed for the floor but not for monsters — he tried twice in seven seconds, so it wants fixing. I also left his 6 HP alone; the camp's spent coal should stay spent.
